This amorphous being is one of Guthix's guardians set to protect the Stone of Jas. He is unlike any creature in the world since he is able to alter his own body into shapes, calling upon worldly elements to perform deadly attacks.

Quest: While Guthix Sleeps

Combat: He's wise to prayer types, so prepare your attacks carefully. He attacks with melee, ranged and mage attacks.
